  <description
               value="Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Titre: Titre — all titre observables (upper bound)', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Every titre observable; the difference to the query above is autoimmune, blood-group and other non-infective titres. Parts: LOINC enumeration (2188, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `&lt;&lt; 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 118590008 |Dilution factor expressed as titer (property) (qualifier value)|`"/>
  <jurisdiction>
    <coding>
      <system value="urn:iso:std:iso:3166"/>
      <code value="DE"/>
      <display value="Germany"/>
    </coding>
  </jurisdiction>
  <purpose
           value="Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated."/>
